description.fallback: Joseph and Erina are shocked at the news of Speedwagon, the gangster explains that his corpse has been found. Out of nowhere, the gangster receives a punch in the stomach from Joseph, angry at his insensitivity towards the elderly Erina. Erina grimly declares that the curse of the Stone Mask is still following them even after 50 years.
